# M Beauty Clinic by Dr. Tess

> Cosmetic, regenerative and medical dermatology with board-certified dermatologist Dr. Tess Mauricio, MD, FAAD, in Beverly Hills, San Diego and Chula Vista, California. Creator of the Time Machine Procedure and one of the developers of the ALMI procedure.

Phone: 1 (833) 462-3288 (toll free, all clinics). Email: info@mbeautyclinic.com. Founded 2004.

## Treatments
- [The Time Machine Procedure](https://proposals.localairegistry.com/mbeauty/treatments/time-machine-procedure/): Look years younger with no surgery.
- [Botox and Fillers](https://proposals.localairegistry.com/mbeauty/treatments/botox-and-fillers/): Soften lines and restore lost volume.
- [ALMI and Regenerative Medicine](https://proposals.localairegistry.com/mbeauty/treatments/almi-regenerative-medicine/): Use your own cells to restore volume.
- [Skin Brightening](https://proposals.localairegistry.com/mbeauty/treatments/skin-brightening/): Even out dark spots and dull tone.
- [Laser and Skin Tightening](https://proposals.localairegistry.com/mbeauty/treatments/laser-and-skin-tightening/): Smoother, firmer skin with little downtime.
- [Acne and Acne Scars](https://proposals.localairegistry.com/mbeauty/treatments/acne-and-acne-scars/): Clear skin and smoother texture.
- [Hair Restoration](https://proposals.localairegistry.com/mbeauty/treatments/hair-restoration/): Regenerative options for thinning hair.
- [Body Contouring](https://proposals.localairegistry.com/mbeauty/treatments/body-contouring/): Contour, tighten and treat veins.
- [Medical Dermatology](https://proposals.localairegistry.com/mbeauty/treatments/medical-dermatology/): Skin checks and everyday skin care.
